issue.title: parser/metadecoders: UnmarshalToMap does not strip a leading UTF-8 BOM

verification_note: Focused issue tests passed in both arms. The full changed-test-file package selection also included ./common/hugio/... and ./tpl/openapi/openapi3/... and failed to compile at the pinned base because those merge-SHA tests reference production APIs added by PR #15364 (e.g. NewSkipBOMReader, hugio.BOM, FileContentPrefix, AssertStringPublished).

arms.better: The run found the correct decoder quickly and made the minimal production change, but took 871 seconds with 57 tool calls and reported 5,431,756 input tokens in tm stats. It also emitted 'hit an unexpected internal problem' and 'got a response it couldn't understand' during submission, then continued to success without clarifying whether a retry happened or whether the result was safe. Improve the user-facing error to identify the failed action and recovery/retry status, and reduce repeated broad test/research cycles. The focused issue tests passed; the entire merged PR's changed-test suite could not compile at its base SHA because several tests depend on production APIs from that merge.

OpenCode stated a compact three-step plan, located UnmarshalToMap and its table-driven tests quickly, added TOML/YAML/JSON cases, and ran the focused package test successfully in about three minutes with 23,664 reported tokens. It could improve by verifying the affected config-loading integration path explicitly in its own run and by reporting the test scope and any mismatch between decoder-level and real config behavior in its final summary.
